name: hausanna-bodenmais
description: Webseite + Admin-Panel für Haus Anna Bodenmais

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @hausanna/shared build && concurrently -n api,web,admin -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @hausanna/api start:dev" "pnpm --filter @hausanna/web dev" "pnpm --filter @hausanna/admin dev"
scripts.import:wordpress: pnpm --filter @hausanna/shared build && pnpm --filter @hausanna/api build && node apps/api/dist/scripts/import-wordpress.js
